author: MiyaECOM
desc: Starting a dropshipping business in 2026? Here's something many beginners overlook: Finding a winning product is only one part of the business. Before spending money on ads, make sure you have these 5 things in place: A clear target audience. A market you can actually serve. A realistic testing budget. Reliable factories and product quality. An efficient order fulfillment system. One thing I've learned from working in e-commerce is that getting orders is exciting, but fulfilling them properly is what helps build a sustainable business. A great product means very little if shipping is slow, quality is inconsistent, or orders are difficult to manage. My advice: Build the foundation before trying to scale. What's the biggest challenge for you right now: product research, finding reliable suppliers, or managing orders? #Dropshipping #Ecommerce #Shopify #ProductSourcing #OrderFulfillment #OnlineBusiness
